items.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08

ctx.x: And we'd have to beg Uncle Don to play. Play. To play. He could outplay Jelly then. I know that guy was buying one of them. But he didn't have to play the kids. D-F-Lovinet.
